device: The offer block, filled with NONE
lede: (festive without a discount. one clay lamp is the only light in every frame, and the offer block that every diwali ad carries is filled in honestly.)
idea: From Navratri to Diwali every jewellery brand runs the same ad: a countdown, a code, a strike-through. This set refuses all three. Five pieces, each photographed by a single diya, each carrying the form every festive ad carries — OFFER, CODE, ENDS — filled in with NONE, NONE, NEVER, and one line that is true: LIGHT, ONE DIYA. The pieces are the five deepest-stocked in the catalogue, because a festive set has to survive the festival.
type: Ivory Velista on wine at 150px, the second word in blush; a Cormorant italic aside; then a JetBrains Mono form with dotted leaders, the one true field in blush. The plate bleeds into the ground through a 140px gradient so the headline sits in the dark just under the flame. Blush CTA with wine text.
review: Pass 1: the layout was proved on an archive still life while the flame frames rendered. The hoops came back as a two-strand twisted rope and were regenerated as a three-strand plait; the huggies submission hit a rate limit and was resent. Pass 2: crops set so each piece sits above the gradient, the huggies' story spec shortened to hold one line.
verdict: NO SALE. over the pastel bracelet is the bravest card in the campaign and the one most likely to be screenshotted.

F1.title: NO CODE.
F1.why: The paperclip chain coiled beside the lamp, the toggle nearest the camera. The flame is the only light; the gold does the rest.
F1.source: Generated tonight (gen 3a30deaa), one product in the frame, the diya as the scale referent.
F1.check: 4mm, 50cm and the 15mm toggle on YF5143; 80 units.

F2.title: NO TIMER.
F2.why: The braided hoops leaning together on a brass thali, rim-lit by the flame so every crossing of the plait shows.
F2.source: Generated tonight (gen 1c68b27f) after a first render twisted the braid into a rope and was rejected.
F2.check: 25mm and the braid on E20267O; 77 units.

F3.title: NO SALE.
F3.why: The pastel rivière in an S on wine silk. Every stone throws a coloured spark from the one flame: the card that argues the price without a number.
F3.check: 5mm cushion stones in the aqua, pink, yellow order and the fold-over clasp on B00681C; 77 units.

F4.title: NO RUSH.
F4.why: The steel spheres coiled once around the foot of the lamp, the gold heart and toggle in front where the light is.
F4.check: 6mm mirror spheres, the gold toggle and the one heart on YF5215; 29 units.

F5.title: NO CATCH.
F5.why: Two tiny satin huggies beside a lamp that dwarfs them. The honest scale is the point: they are small, they are ₹1,099, and that is the whole offer.
F5.check: 12mm across, 6mm deep and the brushed satin finish on E14776S; 16 units.
